title: Haldi Ceremony
subtitle: A splash of Turmeric, a dash of happiness
story: Turmeric paste and blessings mark the beginning of the wedding journey.
designNote: Golden yellows, marigold petals, and turmeric-stained joy.

title: Mehendi Ceremony
subtitle: Henna, Laughter, & Courtyard Songs
dressCode: Casual attire in shades of Blue
story: As the sun sets, hands bloom with intricate mehendi while cousins trade old stories and aunties hum folk tunes. This evening opens our wedding week with color, scent, and playful chaos.
designNote: Terracotta drapes, marigold strings, brass diyas, and hand-painted signage inspired by old bazaar posters.

title: Pellikuturu
subtitle: It's time to get our Ammayi ready for the big day!
story: We start with haldi blessings in a swirl of yellow petals, then turn the volume up for sangeet night. Expect loud beats, inside jokes, and one dramatic family dance battle.
designNote: Mirror-work textiles, retro disco bulbs, hand-block prints, and bright saffron stage backdrops.

title: Vakkaku Sastram
subtitle: As two families unite to exhange traditions and blessings
dressCode: Indian attire in rich jewel tones
story: Sacred pre-wedding rituals that mark the auspicious beginning of the wedding journey.

title: Kalyanam
subtitle: Sacred vows, seven steps & one lifetime
story: At the mandap, with prayers and conch shells in the air, we promise a lifetime to each other.
designNote: Banarasi textures, temple bells, and deep vermilion floral compositions.

title: Reception
subtitle: Celebrating the beginning of forever!
address: Beside Sakshi office , Bengalore highway, Anantapur
story: The celebration continues into the evening with a festive reception, glowing lights, and cherished moments with loved ones.
